titulo: Blazing like 10 billion suns: NASA’s Swift sees a wandering black hole devouring a star
cuerpo: NASA’s Swift Observatory observed a supermassive black hole ripping apart a star more than 30,000 light-years from the center of a distant galaxy. The extraordinary flare briefly outshone its entire host galaxy in ultraviolet light and revealed a black hole about a million times the Sun’s mass.
